tasks.title: Show watering streaks on the plant card

messages.text: Brief: the operator wants each plant card to show how many days in a row it was watered on schedule. Card layout stays as is; the streak sits under the plant name.

Plan: compute the streak from the existing watering log in the plant service, return it with the card payload, and render it as a small line under the name ("Watered on time 6 days running"). A missed day resets it. Tests cover a fresh plant, a reset and a long streak. Proceeding.
Delivered: PR #214 merged. Cards now show the streak line; a plant with no log shows nothing rather than "0 days".
Nice, thanks.

tasks.title: Warn before frost for outdoor plants

messages.text: Brief: outdoor plants should get a reminder the evening before a forecast frost, using the forecast the app already fetches.

Plan: add a nightly check that reads tomorrow's minimum from the cached forecast and queues one reminder per outdoor plant when it drops below 2 °C. Indoor plants are skipped. One question below about the threshold.
2 °C is fine. Make it per plant later if people ask.
Delivered: PR #217 merged. Frost reminders go out at 18:00 local time; the threshold is a constant in the reminder rules for now.

questions.text: Is a fixed 2 °C threshold right for the first version, or should each plant carry its own?

tasks.title: Accept HEIC photos in the plant diary

messages.text: Brief: diary photo uploads from some phones fail because they arrive as HEIC. Convert on upload.
Plan: convert HEIC to JPEG in the upload handler before resizing, keep the original out of storage, and add a fixture image to the upload tests.
Review found the converter ran on the request thread for large photos; moved it to the existing image worker. Delivered: PR #219 merged.

findings.title: HEIC conversion blocks the request thread for large images

dispositions.reason: Moved to the image worker queue

tasks.title: Link care guides from the species page

messages.text: Brief: species pages should link to the matching care guide when one exists.
Plan: match by species id, show a "Care guide" link below the description, hide it when no guide exists. Small change, proceeding.
Delivered: PR #221 merged; 41 of 58 species now show a guide link.

tasks.title: Let people snooze a watering reminder

messages.text: Brief: add a snooze to watering reminders: later today or tomorrow morning.

Plan: two snooze actions on the reminder, stored as a new due time on the reminder row, so the schedule itself is untouched. Snoozing twice is allowed. Tests cover both options and a snooze across midnight.
Good. Tomorrow morning means 8:00 local.
Delivered: PR #224 merged. One CI rerun: the first run hit the hosted runner outage that the status page showed this morning; the rerun passed unchanged.

events.reason: Hosted runner outage during the first run; rerun unchanged

tasks.title: Export the plant diary as CSV

messages.text: Brief: people want their diary as a CSV file for their own records.
Plan: an Export button on the diary page that downloads date, plant, note and photo count. Photos are not included. Proceeding.
Delivered: PR #227 merged. Large diaries stream rather than build in memory.
Brief: species search returns nothing for small misspellings like "monstra".
Plan: use the trigram index the database already has for name search, rank exact prefix matches first. Tests use a few common misspellings.
Delivered: PR #229 merged. "monstra" and "calathia" now find their species first.
Works on my phone too.

tasks.title: Fix chart colours in dark mode

messages.text: Brief: the moisture chart is hard to read in dark mode.
Plan: move the chart to the theme's colour tokens instead of fixed hex values, check both themes on phone and desktop.
Delivered: PR #232 merged. Chart lines and axis labels follow the theme; walked both themes at both widths.

tasks.title: Remove the old daily tips screen

messages.text: Brief: the daily tips screen has been hidden for months; remove it and its data.
Plan: delete the screen, its route, the tips table migration and the seed file; keep the care guides, which used to share the table. Proceeding.
Delivered: PR #234 merged; about 900 lines removed.
Great, love a deletion.
